lines.arrive: A runaway trolley. Left alone, it hits the five, and they stop it.
lines.loop: Pull the lever, and it goes round the loop into him instead. He stops it, and it kills him, when he'd have been fine.
lines.sign: The sign says: loop line. Rejoins main line.
lines.pulled: He stopped it. The five are safe.
lines.stayed: The five stopped it. He's safe.
